card.name: Words inside fixed opioid label phrases
card.fires_on: Single words inside memorized label phrases: 'in' or 'of' right before 'the absence', and the closing part of terms like pyloroduodenal or peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor.

modes.label: In/of before absence
modes.description: The word 'in' or 'of' just before 'the absence' or 'absence of' in opioid warnings.
modes.example: An antagonist should not be administered<< in>> the absence of clinically significant respiratory depression.

modes.label: Ends of long terms
modes.description: The last piece of a long medical term such as pyloroduodenal or the word receptor in PPAR.
modes.example: stenosing peptic ulcer, pyloroduoden<<al>> obstruction and urinary bladder-neck obstruction
